protocol.name: wayluck_picker_unstable_v1

description.summary: asking the user what to share

protocol.description:
Two halves. Any client may ask the user what to share and hear the answer (wayluck_picker_manager_v1): `wayluck pick`, the chooser xdg-desktop-portal-wlr runs. Only the picker wayluck starts to ask the user may see what there is to share and capture it, workspaces not on screen too (wayluck_picker_host_v1): no other client is shown that global.
Unstable: changed in place, without version bumps, until it's frozen.

request.name: pick

description.summary: ask the user what to share

request.description: wayluck shows its picker; the answer comes on the new object. One question at a time: while one is open, another is cancelled at once.

request.name: destroy
request.description: If the picker is still open, it closes, as if cancelled.

event.name: chosen
event.description: As xdg-desktop-portal-wlr's chooser_cmd prints it: "Monitor: NAME" or "Window: ID" (an ext-foreign-toplevel-list identifier).

description.summary: the user chose nothing (or the picker failed)

interface.name: wayluck_picker_host_v1

description.summary: what the picker wayluck started may see and do

interface.description: Only the client wayluck started as its picker sees this global. On bind (once the window manager has offered its workspaces) it hears what can be shared: monitors, workspaces and windows, then done.

description.summary: the picker is done (as if cancelled, if it hadn't chosen)

request.name: thumbnail
request.description: Like ext_image_copy_capture_manager_v1.create_session (without cursors), but the session's frames are no bigger than width × height: the source drawn scaled down to fit, keeping its shape (or as it is, if it fits already). Its buffer_size events say the size.

request.name: workspace_source
request.description: A capture source for a workspace (by its id from a workspace event): its windows, as they're laid out in it, whether it's shown or not.

request.name: share_workspace
request.description: By its id from a workspace event. wayluck makes a virtual output showing it, and whoever asked hears its name ("Monitor: NAME"), or that it was cancelled, if it can't be shared.

event.name: monitor
event.description: In the order the monitors are in. Shared as "Monitor: NAME".

event.name: window
event.description: One of the windows of the workspace named last (in a workspace event before it, since the last monitor event), or with none, of what the monitor named last shows; the topmost first. id is its ext-foreign-toplevel-list identifier (as a number): it's shared as "Window: ID".

event.name: workspace

description.summary: a workspace, on the monitor named last

event.description: As its window manager offered it, by name: the windows after it are its own. id is to capture it (workspace_source).

event.name: closed
event.description: Whoever asked went away: the picker should close (and destroy this).
